snippet.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories – Rutger & Lenja Character Trailer
snippet.description:
A new trailer for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories reveals the return of Rutger and Lenja from Atelier Yumia. Now experienced members of the Aladiss Pioneering Team, the two will support Karia and her companions on their new adventure, with their interactions with new companions revealing new sides of both returning characters.
